name: Hat Yai Flood Evacuation Shelters
license: Coordinates (c) OpenStreetMap contributors, Open Database License (ODbL) 1.0 - https://www.openstreetmap.org/copyright. Shelter designations compiled from public Thai government and news announcements during the November 2025 (B.E. 2568) Hat Yai flood.
accuracy_note: Coordinates are OpenStreetMap facility locations (node position or polygon centroid), not surveyed shelter entrances; expect up to ~100 m offset within large campuses. Shelter designations come from the November 2025 (B.E. 2568) Hat Yai flood response announcements by Hat Yai City, Ban Phru Town, and Kho Hong Town municipalities and the Prime Minister's Office, as compiled by Thai news outlets; activation status and capacity may differ in future flood events. All 8 points verified inside the U-Tapao basin polygon (basin_utapao.geojson, HydroBASINS level 7) with shapely on 2026-06-12.
